task_instruction: Populate res://scenes/main.tscn so Main contains a water depth visualization scene: add a WorldEnvironment with a procedural sky and glow enabled, a DirectionalLight3D with shadows enabled, a MeshInstance3D named Water that uses a 10x10 PlaneMesh subdivided 20x20 with a ShaderMaterial pointing at res://scenes/WaterShader.tres, a Background Node3D holding exactly 5 sphere MeshInstance3Ds at these positions (all within the 10x10 water plane): Sphere at (3.500, 0.200, -1.000); Sphere2 at (4.200, -0.400, 0.800); Sphere3 at (3.800, 0.000, 2.500); Sphere4 at (2.900, -0.600, -2.800); Sphere5 at (4.000, 0.400, -3.500), all with green StandardMaterial3D overrides, and a Camera3D positioned at (0.195, 0.600, -0.042) with a FOV of 110 and all spheres are visible.
author_astra_first_failure: Water requires a ShaderMaterial override (via material_override or surface_material_override)
local_official_message: Depth scene geometry matches tutorial setup
